original_annotations: the flat food placed first
the pink-label jar used afterward

observed_events.description: the flat food placed first, then the pink-label jar used afterward

supported_claims.text: The frames show a flat round tortilla taken from a retail bag and laid out, then a tan smooth spread scooped from a peanut-butter jar onto it. The visible form supports tortillas but not an exact grain recipe or diameter.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent preserve an earlier visually grounded cart goal while adding a different item grounded by a later procedure stage?
construct.belief_before: The cart needs the item used in the first procedure stage.
construct.belief_after: The cart must retain the first item and add the different later-stage item.
construct.required_behavior_change: Preserve the first selection and add the second visually grounded selection.
construct.no_update_failure: The Agent submits only the first item after the update.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent replaces the first item instead of preserving it.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The released words do not distinguish a tortilla from the several loaf and sliced-bread foods in the real public search window. The frames supply the flat tortilla food category; the later instruction adds the spread while retaining the initial item.

instructions.a: Add one retail pack of the food I spread the filling onto so I can make this snack again. A different brand is fine; I don't need a meal kit or a bulk case.
instructions.b: Also add one regular 2-kilogram jar of the smooth spread I scoop from in the next stage, and keep the first item.
instructions.bundled: Add one retail pack of the food I spread the filling onto so I can make this snack again. A different brand is fine; I don't need a meal kit or a bulk case. Also add one regular 2-kilogram jar of the smooth spread I scoop from in the next stage, and keep the first item.

observed.why: The later update adds a second commitment while preserving the first; the ordered frames identify both items.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent preserve an earlier visually grounded cart goal while adding a different item grounded by a later procedure stage?
construct.belief_before: The cart needs one packaged ready-to-use soft flatbread or wrap serving the same use as the early flat food; recipe and brand are not restricted.
construct.belief_after: Keep that packaged flatbread or wrap and add dinnerware containing matching white rounded-square plates with red-and-gray curved lines and leaf shapes.
construct.required_behavior_change: Preserve one acceptable tortilla listing and add one acceptable matching dinnerware listing.
construct.no_update_failure: The Agent submits only the tortilla listing after the update.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent removes the tortilla listing or adds dinnerware with a different shape or pattern.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The footage identifies the soft flatbread used for the rolls and the serving plate’s white surface, layout of the red-and-gray loops and uninterrupted face. The catalog resolves the visual match; the source does not establish a brand or a four-corner outline.

observed_events.description: The wearer cuts red vegetables on a bright green rounded rectangular board; a shallow white pan with a red handle is already beside it.
The wearer turns back to the stove; the same board and pan are in view. The pan is not picked up or used.

supported_claims.text: V0:0–3 show the bright green rounded rectangular board in use; V0:4–7 show the same board and shallow white pan with a red handle at the return to the stove. Exact size and PFAS claims are not inferred from footage.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent keep a visually matched spare food-prep board while incorporating a later practical pan request?
construct.belief_before: Add one food-prep board whose overall colour and approximate shape match the scene; brand, size and material are not constrained.
construct.belief_after: Keep one matching board and add one white 12–13-inch frying pan publicly sold as PFAS-free; a lid is allowed.
construct.required_behavior_change: Retain a scene-matching single board and add the newly requested single pan.
construct.no_update_failure: The Agent submits only the first item after the update.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent replaces the first item instead of preserving it.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request leaves the spare board's colour and general shape to the scene. Public listings alone do not identify those attributes; the scene shows a green approximately rectangular board. Pan colour, nominal diameter and marketed PFAS-free claim are explicit later procurement preferences.

instructions.a: Add a spare food-prep board in the same overall colour and general shape as the one I use near the start. Any brand or size is fine; I only need one board, not a multi-board set.
instructions.b: I need a larger white frying pan too. Add one that's 12–13 inches across and sold as PFAS-free, with or without a lid; keep the board.
instructions.bundled: Add a spare food-prep board in the same overall colour and general shape as the one I use near the start. Any brand or size is fine; I only need one board, not a multi-board set. Also add one white frying pan, 12–13 inches across and sold as PFAS-free, with or without a lid.

Nonfood pool/softener salt, sodium-free salt substitute and container-only products do not supply that pantry need.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent preserve an earlier visually grounded cart goal while adding a different item grounded by a later procedure stage?

construct.required_behavior_change: Preserve the first selection and add the second visually grounded selection.
construct.no_update_failure: The cart ends with only the first purchase after B adds the second need.
construct.overupdate_failure: The Agent replaces the first item instead of preserving it.

addressed_review: 2026-10-31 独立 Coding Agent 画面必要性审核（necessity-reviewer-B，.scratch/necessity-20261030/reviews/candidate-mart-graft-p-35.json）判为文字捷径：V0_00-03 show a yellow lemon squeezed by hand over a bowl of corn, and V0_04-07 show a silver solid-bowled spoon mixing that bowl. Part A: the lemon adds nothing, because every handheld citrus press fits a lemon (colour and brand are free). Part B: silver plus solid spoon excludes only the gold and black spoon variants, slotted spoons and a mixing paddle. The catalog has no wooden spoons, silicone spatulas or whisks: the query 'wooden spoon' returns 41/48 acceptable, 'mixing spoon' returns 40/48 and even the image-free guess 'green mixing spoon' returns 39/48. 修复方向：Give the spoon window the real alternatives a user mixing a bowl might own, such as wooden spoons, silicone spatulas, coloured or plastic spoons and whisks. Then 'matching its kind and colour' can only be satisfied by seeing the silver metal spoon. The press half cannot be repaired from these frames: a plain lemon does not separate one handheld citrus press from another, so leave that half as the preserved first item rather than adding invented requirements.
